title: Balochistan Land Revenue Second Amendment Ordinance 1978

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Land Revenue Second Amendment Ordinance 1978
sections.description:
Short title, extent and commencement

ORDINANCE VII OF 1978
ORDINANCE VII OF 1978
BALUCHISTAN LAND REVENUE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1978
An Ordinance to further amend the
Baluchistan Land Revenue Act, 1967.
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 23rd February, 1978]
No. Legis 1-47/Law/71.--The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 13th
February, 1978 is hereby published for general information.
1. Short title, extent and commencement.-- This Ordinance may be
called the Baluchistan Land Revenue (Second Amendment) Ordinance. 1978.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the harvest of Rabi
Crop 1976-77.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 56-A of Act XVII of 1967

ORDINANCE VII OF 1978
ORDINANCE VII OF 1978
BALUCHISTAN LAND REVENUE (SECOND AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1978
An Ordinance to further amend the
Baluchistan Land Revenue Act, 1967.
[Gazette of Baluchistan, Extraordinary, 23rd February, 1978]
No. Legis 1-47/Law/71.--The
following Ordinance made by the Governor of Baluchistan on the 13th
February, 1978 is hereby published for general information.
2. Amendment of section 56-A of Act XVII of 1967.-In the
Baluchistan Land Revenue Act, 1967 (Act, XVII of 1967) hereinafter referred to
as the Principal Act, the following amendments shall be made :-
In section 56-A
(i) in clause (a) for the word
"twelve" the word "twenty five" shall be substituted.
(ii) in clause (b) for the void
"twenty five" the word "fifty" shall be substituted.
(iii) in clause (c) for the word
"'twelve" the word "twenty five" shall be substituted.

a land owner owning :

or
